snippet.title: Super Monkey Ball 2: Bad-Boon Strikes Back v4.0 - Advanced
snippet.description:
Playthrough of KartingKoopa's Super Monkey Ball 2 mod, "Bad-Boon Strikes Back v4.0". This video completes 40 stages (30 normal, 10 extra) found in the Advanced and Advanced Extra difficulties.

Sorry for the stupid deaths, was rushing while recording this one...

Download the pack here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rxVdh5MRqWo9S8vSYiNrzRn3g-n3nRyY/view?usp=sharing

Played on Dolphin Emulator using a DS4 controller.
I hope everyone enjoys and feel free to like, comment, and subscribe!
